01 / ABOUT THE GAME

History sets the scene.
Your decisions shape what follows.

Take the flight director’s seat in a narrative game inspired by real missions and the people who made them possible.

You are Glen Kurtz: a fictional tribute to the legendary Gene Kranz, whose leadership helped guide Mission Control through pivotal moments of Gemini and Apollo. The signature vest is a nod to Kranz; Glen’s story is his own. Ageless by design, he represents generations of flight directors, from the earliest missions to those still ahead.

Listen to your controllers. Weigh incomplete information. Make the call, then live with its consequences. Follow the historical path or branch into an alternate outcome. The astronauts are real; the decisions and consequences blend documented events with clearly identified fiction.

01

Read the room.

Your controllers see different risks. Ask questions and work through the evidence before you commit.

02

03 / ABOUT THE DEV

A lifelong dream.
A new trajectory.

I’m Dan Lee-Odinson, a Technical Project Manager and Space Studies student at Everglades University.

My fascination with space began when I was six, holding my breath as Discovery’s STS-26 crew launched on the historic Return to Flight after the Challenger disaster. Watching Artemis II lift off in April 2026 turned that lifelong passion into a determination to be part of what comes next.

Since then, I’ve been working toward one goal: to learn everything I can and bring my skills to a future career in Mission Operations and Program Management.

I’m inspired by the people of NASA and the space agencies and companies around the world expanding what humanity can do in space—and by the dedication of everyone on the ground who makes those journeys possible.

This game is my tribute to you all.

04 / THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE MISSION

Made as a tribute.

To the men and women of NASA, whose bravery, sacrifice, and vision embody the best of humanity.

To those who journeyed beyond our world, and to all whose work made those journeys possible.

Independent project

Failure is Not an Option is an independent homage to NASA and the people of the space program, created for appreciation and exploration, not for profit. It is not affiliated with, authorized, sponsored, or endorsed by NASA.

Inspired by real missions and people, this game includes fictional dialogue, simplified systems, and alternate historical outcomes. These elements do not represent the actual words, beliefs, or actions of the people portrayed. NASA is not responsible for the game's interpretations, generated content, or accuracy.

NASA marks & generated artwork

Failure is Not an Option is not sponsored, endorsed, or authorized by NASA. We seek to respectfully follow NASA’s published media and brand guidelines, including its restrictions on NASA insignia, logotypes, and seals appearing with AI-generated imagery. The game uses an original fictional emblem for its generated artwork and branding.

NASA marks visible in authentic photographs or archival footage remain part of their original real-world context and do not imply NASA sponsorship or endorsement.

Read NASA’s Images and Media Guidelines ↗

AI disclosure

This project was created using generative AI within a human-in-the-loop process, with human creative direction, review, and final decision-making.
